name: Gethin Woods (Bike Park Merthyr)

fields.description: BikePark Wales at Gethin Woods is a major South Wales mountain biking destination with uplift service, coaching, bike hire and a broad trail network for different riding levels. Use the official BikePark Wales website for current booking, opening and trail-status information.
